<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<rules lang="de">
<rule id="AP_NONE" name="AP_NONE"><pattern><token postag="ADJ:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/><token postag="SUB:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></pattern><disambig action="ignore_spelling"/></rule>
<rule id="AP_LEFT" name="AP_LEFT"><antipattern><token postag="ADJ:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></antipattern><pattern><token postag="ADJ:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/><token postag="SUB:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></pattern><disambig action="ignore_spelling"/></rule>
<rule id="AP_RIGHT" name="AP_RIGHT"><antipattern><token postag="SUB:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></antipattern><pattern><token postag="ADJ:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/><token postag="SUB:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></pattern><disambig action="ignore_spelling"/></rule>
<rule id="AP_SAME" name="AP_SAME"><antipattern><token postag="ADJ:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/><token postag="SUB:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></antipattern><pattern><token postag="ADJ:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/><token postag="SUB:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></pattern><disambig action="ignore_spelling"/></rule>
<rule id="AP_PARTIAL_LEFT" name="AP_PARTIAL_LEFT"><antipattern><token postag="ART:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/><token postag="ADJ:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></antipattern><pattern><token postag="ADJ:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/><token postag="SUB:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></pattern><disambig action="ignore_spelling"/></rule>
<rule id="AP_PARTIAL_RIGHT" name="AP_PARTIAL_RIGHT"><antipattern><token postag="SUB:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/><token postag="VER:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></antipattern><pattern><token postag="ADJ:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/><token postag="SUB:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></pattern><disambig action="ignore_spelling"/></rule>
<rule id="AP_LONGER" name="AP_LONGER"><antipattern><token postag="ART:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/><token postag="ADJ:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/><token postag="SUB:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/><token postag="VER:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></antipattern><pattern><token postag="ADJ:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/><token postag="SUB:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></pattern><disambig action="ignore_spelling"/></rule>
<rule id="AP_TWO" name="AP_TWO"><antipattern><token postag="PRP:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></antipattern><antipattern><token postag="ADJ:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></antipattern><pattern><token postag="ADJ:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/><token postag="SUB:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></pattern><disambig action="ignore_spelling"/></rule>
<rule id="AP_TWO_NOMATCH" name="AP_TWO_NOMATCH"><antipattern><token postag="PRP:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></antipattern><antipattern><token>zzzz</token></antipattern><pattern><token postag="ADJ:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/><token postag="SUB:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></pattern><disambig action="ignore_spelling"/></rule>
<rule id="AP_SENT_START" name="AP_SENT_START"><antipattern><token postag="SENT_START"/><token postag="ART:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></antipattern><pattern><token postag="ADJ:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/><token postag="SUB:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></pattern><disambig action="ignore_spelling"/></rule>
<rule id="AP_MARKER" name="AP_MARKER"><antipattern><token postag="ART:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/><marker><token postag="ADJ:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></marker></antipattern><pattern><token postag="ADJ:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/><token postag="SUB:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></pattern><disambig action="ignore_spelling"/></rule>
<rule id="AP_MARKER_RIGHT" name="AP_MARKER_RIGHT"><antipattern><marker><token postag="SUB:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></marker><token postag="VER:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></antipattern><pattern><token postag="ADJ:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/><token postag="SUB:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></pattern><disambig action="ignore_spelling"/></rule>
<rule id="AP_SKIP" name="AP_SKIP"><antipattern><token postag="ART:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/><token postag="ADJ:.*" postag_regexp="yes" skip="-1"/><token postag="VER:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></antipattern><pattern><token postag="ADJ:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/><token postag="SUB:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></pattern><disambig action="ignore_spelling"/></rule>
<rule id="AP_MIN0" name="AP_MIN0"><antipattern><token postag="ART:.*" postag_regexp="yes" min="0"/><token postag="ADJ:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></antipattern><pattern><token postag="ADJ:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/><token postag="SUB:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></pattern><disambig action="ignore_spelling"/></rule>
<rule id="AP_REGEXP" name="AP_REGEXP"><antipattern><token regexp="yes">.*[aeiou].*</token></antipattern><pattern><token postag="ADJ:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/><token postag="SUB:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></pattern><disambig action="ignore_spelling"/></rule>
<rule id="AP_UNIFY" name="AP_UNIFY"><antipattern><unify><feature id="num"/><token postag="ADJ:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/><token postag="SUB:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></unify></antipattern><pattern><token postag="ADJ:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/><token postag="SUB:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></pattern><disambig action="ignore_spelling"/></rule>
<unification feature="num"><equivalence type="sg"><token postag=".*:SIN:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></equivalence><equivalence type="pl"><token postag=".*:PLU:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></equivalence></unification>
<rulegroup id="GRP_SHARED" name="grp"><antipattern><token postag="ADJ:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></antipattern><rule><pattern><token postag="ADJ:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/><token postag="SUB:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></pattern><disambig action="ignore_spelling"/></rule><rule><pattern><token postag="ART:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/><token postag="ADJ:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></pattern><disambig action="ignore_spelling"/><antipattern><token postag="SUB:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></antipattern></rule><rule><pattern><token postag="SUB:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/><token postag="VER:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></pattern><disambig action="ignore_spelling"/></rule></rulegroup>
<rulegroup id="GRP_NOSHARE" name="grp2"><rule><pattern><token postag="ADJ:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/><token postag="SUB:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></pattern><disambig action="ignore_spelling"/></rule><rule><pattern><token postag="ART:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/><token postag="ADJ:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></pattern><disambig action="ignore_spelling"/></rule></rulegroup>
<rulegroup id="GRP_OWN" name="grp3"><rule><pattern><token postag="ADJ:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/><token postag="SUB:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></pattern><disambig action="ignore_spelling"/><antipattern><token postag="ADJ:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></antipattern></rule><rule><pattern><token postag="ADJ:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/><token postag="SUB:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></pattern><disambig action="immunize"/></rule></rulegroup>
<rule id="AP_IN_REPLACE" name="AP_IN_REPLACE"><antipattern><token postag="ART:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/><token postag="ADJ:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></antipattern><pattern><token postag="ART:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/><marker><token postag="ADJ:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></marker><token postag="SUB:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></pattern><disambig postag="SUB:NOM:SIN:MAS"/></rule>
<rule id="AP_IN_FILTER" name="AP_IN_FILTER"><antipattern><token postag="SUB:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></antipattern><pattern><token postag="ADJ:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/><token postag="SUB:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></pattern><disambig action="filter" postag="SUB:.*"/></rule>
<rule id="AP_IN_ADD" name="AP_IN_ADD"><antipattern><token postag="SUB:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></antipattern><pattern><token postag="ADJ:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/><token postag="SUB:.*" postag_regexp="yes"/></pattern><disambig action="add"><wd lemma="AP" pos="XAP"/><wd lemma="AP2" pos="XAP2"/></disambig></rule>
</rules>
texts: Der Mann geht schnell nach Hause.
Die Häuser sind groß und die Frau kann gehen.
Ich sah sie in der Stadt.
Das große Haus steht am Fluss.
Er will den Zug nehmen, aber der Zug ist weg.
Eine kleine Katze schläft auf dem Sofa.
